verification_notes: Author-hosted Bailey PDF initial direct fetch timed out; subsequent primary-domain search returned paper title/authors/date and author directory citation. Claim limited to selection-overfit motivation, no numeric theorem invoked.
OTexts section URLs redirected to toolbox/judgmental chapter pages; canonical URLs retained.
scikit stable pages observed1.9.1 on research date; no dependency version installed or selected.
No provider or model calls; web reads only.

Review-fix timing protocols are MP engineering proposals: +15/+40/+60/+75 minute daily clocks require later owner/source/runtime proof; three earnings modes enforce point-in-time admission. Offline timing_checks.py validates artificial scenarios only, without new source reads, acquisition, model calls or empirical claims.

MP-20 consolidation (3 Nov 2026): the three event modes, first written for earnings, now apply to all seven first-wave event kinds (owner decision); unscheduled kinds have no prerelease mode. No new external source was read for the consolidation; each event source's rights remain to be checked before use.
